title: Law to make 311 forward complaints to the right agency
summary: This bill would require NYC311 to redirect service requests or complaints to the agency with proper jurisdiction when an agency reports it cannot act on one. NYC311 would have to reopen the request, determine the correct agency and forward it there, and notify the person who filed it. The same process would apply when someone asks to reopen a closed request through a satisfaction survey. The law would take effect 180 days after enactment.
